change.title: Move set_settings Science wait outside AppState with owner CAS
change.summary: Extends the existing process-local Science stop owner boundary to set_settings. A teardown claims the exact owner and typed stop request under AppState, executes the existing stop policy without AppState, and publishes only after generation and complete owner CAS. A stale result preserves replacement Science state, the tracked Gateway, and the prior durable settings.

basis: set_mode, set_settings, and stop_all share one process-local owner claim and publication implementation while retaining their distinct Gateway, generation, cleanup, and error semantics
the R2 regression covers generation-only and identity-only drift, proves AppState remains readable during stop, and rejects stale publication before settings, generation, or Gateway changes
the existing R0 set_settings characterizations continue to freeze journal preflight, stop failure, SSH cleanup failure, and config-commit failure ordering
the static Science runtime boundary binds claim-execute-relock-publish-bump-stop-revoke-commit ordering in set_settings
downgrade cleanup and every other remaining Science stop owner stay outside this bounded slice
